state.question: For Ember Station, what do the latest records show about heat rate? Please resolve this specific point: The measured heat rate before and after the replacement under the same load band.
state.conclusion: Ember replaced a turbine section during its maintenance outage.
state.gap: The measured heat rate before and after the replacement under the same load band.

candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Amara Fox's Dispatch's dispatch on Ember Station, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Ember Station's strategy in heat rate, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Ember Station, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of the measured heat rate before and after the replacement under the same load band.

candidates.abstract: Ember acceptance-run report supports a dated assessment of the measured heat rate before and after the replacement under the same load band.
